aesthetic: Pressroom Meridian — an editorial system that moves like a broadsheet at golden hour, warm and papery at dawn, cooling to deep ocean blue by dusk
chromaticArc: Slides 1–12 rest on warm linen with amber punctuation; slides 13–22 introduce Slate Meridian as the accent tone while linen holds the ground; slides 23–32 let slate migrate to backgrounds on 2 section dividers; slides 33–38 close on Deep Ink dividers and cool grey-white grounds, completing the warm-to-cold transit.
gridStrategy: Each slide cycles through one of four zone archetypes — full-bleed title (col 0 span 58), right-offset statement (col 30 span 28), left-sidebar body split (col 0 span 18 / col 22 span 36), and centred column (col 12 span 36) — sequenced to prevent any two consecutive slides from sharing the same archetype.

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: Georgia appears on ~6 slides (roughly every 6th): opening title, key-insight statements, and any slide carrying a direct quote or single-sentence thesis — always at weight 400 to emphasise warmth over authority

accentStrategy: Thin horizontal rules (type: line, height 1px, Harvest Amber or Slate Meridian) divide title from body zones on 40% of slides; 5–6 slides add a narrow vertical bar (col span 1, full row height) in amber as left-margin punctuation on sidebar layouts.
